default_description: A curated selection of refined tea-time favourites and warm savouries to welcome guests with com- fort and familiarity. Thoughtfully plated, light yet indulgent bites to set the tone for the celebrations ahead.
An elegant parade of handcrafted small plates served warm on pass-around Global flavours along with Indian technique, designed for effortless grazing and conversation.
A rotating selection of starters served fresh at stations throughout the evening.
A reimagined Indian street food experience, prepared live with precision and finesse. Classic flavours, elevated presentation, and interactive plating for a playful yet refined indulgence.

A lavish spread of international cheeses, breads, pâtés, dips, and accompaniments for relaxed, free-flowing nibbling. Perfect for pre-dinner mingling and cocktail conversations, styled for both taste and visual drama.
Hand-rolled sushi prepared live, showcasing Japanese precision and premium ingredients. A delicate balance of freshness, texture, and umami, served with traditional accompaniments.
Steamed and pan-seared dumplings crafted live, inspired by classic East Asian flavours. Light, aromatic bites with bold fillings, served straight from the steamer for peak freshness.
Pan-seared gyoza crafted live, served with dipping sauces.
Steamed bao buns filled to order with vegetarian and non-vegetarian fillings.

Charcoal-grilled skewers prepared over open flame, echoing the vibrant energy of Japanese street grills. Smoky, succulent proteins and vegetables glazed with signature sauces for irresistible aroma and flavour.
A comforting late-evening noodle bar serving hot, customisable Japanese-style ramen bowls. Slow-simmered broths, fresh noodles, and curated toppings come together for soulful midnight indul- gence.
Interactive Japanese-style grill where proteins and vegetables are seared to order. Bold sauces, high heat, and theatrical plating for a modern Asian dining experience.
A refined cold counter featuring delicately sliced and citrus-cured seafood and vegetables. Freshly dressed with premium oils, herbs, and bright acidity for a light, elegant contrast to warm grills.
Indonesian-style skewers grilled live, finished with peanut sauce.
Delicate galouti kebabs finished on the mahi tawa, melting on the palate.
Regional Indian charcoal grill — lamb chops, tangri and robust Punjabi flavours.
A tribute to the refined culinary traditions of Awed live on the tawa. Delicately spiced kebabs and artisanal breads crafted with old-world finesse and depth of flavour.
Warm flatbreads, shawarma, falafel, and mezze inspired by the vibrant kitchens of the Levant. Fragrant spices, slow-roasted proteins, and creamy dips for soulful Mediterranean indulgence.
A lighter Levantine spread — mezze, falafel and shawarma carved live.
Stone-baked gourmet pizzas prepared live with premium toppings and hand-stretched bases. Classic Italian comfort elevated with fresh produce, fine cheeses, and bold flavour combinations.
Stone-baked pizzas prepared live with classic toppings.
Fajitas, guacamole and salsas prepared live with Monterey Jack.
Comforting, aromatic soups served hot to awaken the palate between courses. A balance of global and Indian classics, crafted for warmth and gentle indulgence.
A refreshing medley of crisp greens, global salads, and herb-forward compositions. Designed to balance richer flavours with brightness, crunch, and natural freshness.
Traditional Indian accompaniments presented in a refined format. Crunchy papads, artisanal pickles, and cooling raitas to complement robust main courses.
The Indian curry section — slow-cooked vegetarian and non-vegetarian classics.
A curated showcase of The Embassy Restaurant's most celebrated legacy recipes and house specialities. Timeless North Indian classics prepared with depth, richness, and heritage flavours.
Slow-cooked curries and regal preparations inspired by Mughal culinary traditions. Luxuriously spiced gravies, rich textures, and indulgent aromas rooted in royal kitchens.
A comforting, flavour-forward selection from the Parsi culinary repertoire. Sweet, tangy, and gently spiced preparations that bring warmth and nostalgia to the table.
A vibrant showcase of Thai and South East Asian flavours. Fragrant curries, wok-tossed vegetables, and bold chilli-forward sauces for balanced heat and freshness.
An interactive wok station — choice of ingredients tossed in the sauce of your liking.
Fragrant dum-cooked biryanis and aromatic rice dishes served with traditional accompaniments. Layered flavours, slow cooking, and soulful spice blends for hearty indulgence.
Fresh pasta tossed live with classic sauces and seasonal toppings. Customisable, comforting, and indulgent, crafted to order for each guest.
Freshly baked Indian breads prepared live from the tandoor and tawa. Soft, flaky, and aromatic accompaniments to elevate every curry and grill. Butter naan
A nostalgic celebration of India's most loved sweets, prepared and finished live. Warm, syrupy, and saffron-kissed indulgences crafted for traditional sweetness lovers.
A refined selection of European-style desserts and baked classics. Creamy, chocolate-forward, and indulgent finales to complete the dining journey.
A curated selection of hot beverages to accompany desserts and late-evening conversations. Comforting brews served with quiet elegance to conclude the celebration.
